description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 3030012837168 BELT,V: Line 0001 Qty 360 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0038 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 54. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 01637 JC544LB; 1VZM7 17540; 24161 9540; 44185 M9540. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
